defect: run_dump_circuits checked lexical repository containment only after writing every file, allowing rejected outside paths to have already created or overwritten files; symlink escapes were not checked
repair: Preflight every destination against normalized absolute and weakly canonical repository paths before any publication. Revalidate each path immediately before writing. Keep existing explicit partial-write behavior for later ordinary I/O failures.
tests_both_boards: Direct external output directory rejected without creating files
Parent traversal rejected without creating files
Parent-directory symlink escaping repository rejected without creating files
Last circuit path symlink to outside sentinel rejected before any earlier circuit is published; sentinel unchanged
Contained output alias and symlinked repository root accepted with complete byte-identical publication
Existing ordinary late-I/O-error contract retains earlier successfully published files

validation.includes: Full unit, placement probe and both-board catalog suite

limits: This is pre-write validation, not an atomic sandbox against concurrent hostile symlink replacement. It does not change the unrestricted single-dump publication API, which has no repository-root argument.
